clusters.name: High-Potential Growth Champions
clusters.opportunity: Untapped growth in accounts already highly inclined to buy and scale.
clusters.marketingStrategy: Personalised premium-machine upsell; exclusive product previews; ROI-led proposals.
clusters.salesAction: Assign senior/dedicated account managers; quarterly executive business reviews.

clusters.name: Loyal Profitable Core
clusters.opportunity: Reliable margin base; long-term contract retention & advocacy.
clusters.marketingStrategy: 'Benefits Bonanza' loyalty/rewards program; service excellence; modest cross-sell.
clusters.salesAction: Efficient farming cadence; NPS checks & renewal focus.

clusters.name: Under-Profiled Active Accounts
clusters.opportunity: Hidden revenue upside once accounts are fully profiled and scored.
clusters.marketingStrategy: Complete segmentation data drive; then targeted cross-sell campaigns.
clusters.salesAction: Data-capture push; discovery calls to score share/potential.

clusters.name: Contested-Market Prospects
clusters.opportunity: Land-and-expand opportunities where competitor presence is active.
clusters.marketingStrategy: Competitive-defense & switching offers; localized metro campaigns.
clusters.salesAction: Targeted outbound sales in priority competitive metros.

clusters.name: Open-Market Prospects
clusters.opportunity: Low-cost digital reach; long-tail prospective conversion.
clusters.marketingStrategy: Automated low-touch nurture; lead-scoring gate before sales spend.
clusters.salesAction: Inside-sales only on qualified/scored high-intent leads.

takeaways.title: MNAR Prospect Structure (58.7% Unprofiled)
takeaways.description: Missingness in Revenue/Profit/Share is not random data loss; 1,778 accounts go missing together, representing unprofiled prospective accounts ('never transacted').

takeaways.title: Honest Structural Caveat (Profiled vs Full)
takeaways.description: Full silhouette (0.60) is inflated by the prospect gap. Re-running on profiled subset (0.21-0.35) confirms Growth Champions are a hard archetype, while Loyal Core is an operational action tier.

takeaways.title: Redundancy Pruning via Cramér's V
takeaways.description: Casino_Size_Segment dropped due to Cramér's V = 0.97 with Market_Potential. Geography excluded from model to avoid geography-led clustering, kept as pure profiling overlay.

takeaways.title: Multi-Method Outlier Robustness
takeaways.description: Isolation Forest sweep across 0.5%–5% contamination proved high seed ARI stability. Outliers do not distort the underlying K=5 cluster boundaries.
